plain: Loss of loyalty toward a leader or government.

webster.text: Alienation of affection, attachment or good will; want of affection; or more generally, positive enmity, dislike or unfriendliness; disloyalty.

example.quote: Can these local governments be sufficient to protect us from foreign enemies, or from disaffection at home ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Rev. Mr. THACHER, February 4, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
